name: 1P-ETH-LAD
summary: A new psychedelic lysergamide which is suspected to be a prodrug of ETH-LAD, which could explain why the doses are very similar, it alternatively could be active on its own. There are no studies on it currently.
advisory: These doses are very tentative, and are based on the likelihood that the dosage profile will be similar to ETH-LAD.

pharmacology.text: Research has shown formation of ETH-LAD from 1P-ETH-LAD incubated in human serum, suggesting that it functions as a prodrug.

uses.text: Like ETH-LAD, this drug has been reported to be significantly more potent than LSD itself, and is reported to largely mimic ETH-LAD's psychedelic effects.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the lysergamides such as LSD, cause strong changes in perception and mood, and can bring anxiety, panic, confusion, a faster heartbeat and nausea. In some people they can trigger lasting mental health problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的麥角醯胺類藥物（例如LSD）會強烈改變知覺與情緒，也可能帶來焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、心跳加快與噁心。對部分人可能引發長期的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的麦角酰胺类药物（例如LSD）会强烈改变知觉与情绪，也可能带来焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、心跳加快与恶心。对部分人可能引发长期的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its parent, ETH-LAD, carries an ethyl group where LSD has a methyl group on the nitrogen at position 6.
fact.zh: 它的母體ETH-LAD在LSD第6號位置氮上的甲基處改為乙基。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体ETH-LAD在LSD第6号位置氮上的甲基处改为乙基。
